name: ges-live-system-preview
description: Source lives in src/ (data.js, canvas.js, app.js, index.template.html), plus the root styles.css (hand-edited, no src/ copy). Run `npm run build` to compile it all into a single self-contained index.html at the repo root, with styles.css and the app bundle inlined directly into it - that ONE file is the entire deployable site, download its raw contents from GitHub and drop it straight into WordPress, no other files needed. app.js is also still written at the repo root as an intermediate build artifact (useful for diffing changes), but nothing needs to be uploaded alongside index.html anymore. Never hand-edit the root index.html or app.js directly - edit src/ and rebuild - but styles.css is the exception: it's only ever read by the build, never written, so hand-editing it directly is correct.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/app.js --bundle --outfile=app.js --loader:.js=jsx --jsx-factory=React.createElement --jsx-fragment=React.Fragment --banner:js="// Built from src/ via npm run build - do not edit this file directly.
// (c) Gold Eagle Services, Austin, TX. All rights reserved. Proprietary software - unauthorized copying or reuse is a violation of U.S. copyright law. GES-HVAC-CONFIGURATOR-PROVENANCE-ID: ges-live-system-2026-austin-tx" && node scripts/build-html.js
